notes: The targeted Item 7 excerpt was empty, so scoring rests on Item 1 alone. The Human Capital section is well over 150 words, so Community and Cross-cultural are sufficient and no second look is triggered. The Cross-cultural score of 2 is borderline: the local-language hotline is an ethics/compliance mechanism, but it is a concrete multilingual access practice comparable to multilingual support. Statements about increasing female hires and interns and encouraging university engineering programs to emphasize opportunities for women are aspirational ('we aim', 'we remain committed') and were not scored. Mentions of 16 countries of operation, sales in Asia, and trademark registrations abroad are international operations only and do not count. The Corporate Social Responsibility section refers to the website for details and covers environmental and supply-chain matters, not the four themes.
